mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO med_slot ( schedule_id, work_date, start_time, end_time, booking_deadline, total_capacity, remaining_capacity, status ) VALUES
( #{slot.scheduleId}, #{slot.workDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{slot.startTime,jdbcType=TIME}, #{slot.endTime,jdbcType=TIME}, #{slot.bookingDeadline,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{slot.totalCapacity}, #{slot.remainingCapacity}, #{slot.status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select: SELECT slot.id AS slot_id, slot.booking_deadline, slot.remaining_capacity, slot.status AS slot_status, schedule.status AS schedule_status FROM med_slot slot INNER JOIN med_schedule schedule ON schedule.id = slot.schedule_id WHERE slot.id = #{slotId}
